title: Encryption without authentication
message: Encryption has no associated ciphertext authentication operation in its resolved scope.
remediation: Use an AEAD mode or authenticate the ciphertext with a MAC.

title: Hardcoded or predictable key
message: A key or key-derivation password originates from a source-code literal, bundled plaintext resource, or predictable system property.
remediation: Load keys from a protected secret store or derive them from a strong secret with a KDF.

evidence.code: this.keyStore.setKeyEntry("jenkins", privateKey, password, new X509Certificate[] { identityCertificate })
